Guided setup

What it’s like to have your own agent.

One agent, on your own computer, quietly working through the inbox, the calendar, the errands, and the research you never get to.

Quietly sorting the inbox checking the calendar drafting a reply gathering research sorting the inbox

Which one is this?

A walkthrough · you are here

Connecting an inbox, a calendar and a chat app on one computer is an hour with us, and you leave able to run it and change it yourself.

Design and build work

More than one calendar, tools you have already wired together, or several pieces that have to keep working without you in the middle. That is Consulting: we scope it, quote the whole thing, then build it. Both are $250 an hour, so the question is not which is cheaper. It is which one your setup is.

What it takes on

The small stuff, handled.

The repetitive work, off your plate: it drafts, sorts, and reminds. Email goes out only when you send it or set a time.

Email & InboxFlags priority messages and proposes ready-to-send replies
Scheduling & RemindersSuggests best slots and drafts confirmation messages
Research & LookupsBuilds ranked lists and summarizes options with next steps
Lists & TrackingKeeps running lists (follow-ups, applications, plans) and answers questions about them
Following Up with ContactsPrepares personalized check-ins using recent context
Daily BriefingsSurfaces your schedule, priority emails, and key reminders each morning
The product

Archie is how you get one.

Archie is our desktop app for building personal AI agents that run on your own computer, through your own accounts. If it can’t do something yet, tell us, and we’ll build the add-on.

Meet Archie →

Archie is in testing. The waitlist hears the day it opens. See where it stands →

Pricing

One rate, told up front.

$250 a session. Each session runs an hour. The rate never goes up because your setup is complicated, but a bigger setup can take more than one session. We’ll tell you how many on the free call, before you book anything.

Archie itself is $30 a month or $299 a year when it ships, a separate cost from your sessions.

The AI itself bills you directly, never through us. While we build together that’s a standard subscription like Claude Pro, around $20 a month. After that it’s your own pay-as-you-go account. What that runs to is on the pricing page.

The free call

What you walk away with.

Whether or not you book a session afterwards. It is yours either way.

What to hand over

The parts of your week an agent could take on, named specifically, rather than “email and calendar”.

Which add-ons do it

By name, with what each one needs connected before it can work.

What it would cost to run

Worked from what you actually do, on the same figures as the pricing page. The AI bill is the part people guess wrong.

What not to automate

The parts we would leave alone, and why. There are always some.

Whether it’s the wrong tool

Said plainly, on the call, if that is the answer. Sometimes it is, and you have lost an hour instead of a year.

Cost of all 5: nothing. There is no follow-up sequence either. We take the call, send you the plan, and leave it with you. We are two people, so this is a handful of calls a week rather than a booking form that never fills up.
